Title: DB.DBA.RDF_TRIPLES_TO_RDF_XML_TEXT (
Description:
Serializes vector of triples into a session, in TURTLE syntax. In current version, every triple is printed in separate top-level record (say, in rdf:Description tag),
without any pretty-print or nesting optimization.
Examples: create procedure simple_test(in query varchar, in dflt_graph varchar)
